scenarios.reasoning: The agent did solid investigative work extracting information from the binlog and correctly identified the configuration mismatch (Debug vs Release) as the cause of the MSB3030 error. However, it incorrectly concluded that LrgWindowsAppManifest was included in the solution build, when the evidence (defaulting to Debug config while the solution builds Release) suggests it was NOT in the solution configuration. The fix suggestion ('map to Release') is reasonable but based on an incorrect diagnosis of the project's relationship to the solution. The project listing was mentioned but not fully enumerated.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
